title: Protocol for Wash Aliquoting of Buffers
author: Opentrons
materials: This protocol performs aliquoting of multiple buffers from different reservoirs into multiple 2 mL KingFisher deep well plates.

steps.title: Aliquot Wash 1 Solution
steps.instruction: Aliquot 500 µL from the 15 mL -12 section reservoir (wash 1 solution) into a 96‑well, 2 mL deep‑well plate.

steps.title: Aliquot Wash 2 (80% EtOH)
steps.instruction: Aliquot 1000 µL from the 15 mL -12 section reservoir (wash 2, 80% EtOH) into a second 96‑well, 2 mL deep‑well plate.

steps.title: Aliquot Elution Buffer
steps.instruction: Aliquot 50 µL from the 15 mL -12 section reservoir (elution buffer) into a 96‑well, 2 mL deep‑well plate.
